title: ⚠️ Warning for Developers: Fake Copies of a Popular Coding Extension Sneaked into a Well-Known Extension Store!
body: ⚠️ Warning for Developers: Fake Copies of a Popular Coding Extension Sneaked into a Well-Known Extension Store!

Cursor revealed that an attacker exploited a stolen access key the company had given to another company, and placed malicious copies of the “Claude Code” extension in the store, reaching up to 5,000 users in about eleven hours. The most dangerous copy planted a permanent backdoor that allows remote access to the victim’s device. The company confirmed that the original extension itself is safe, and that the danger was only in the fake copies.
The lesson: only install extensions from their official source, and always review updates.
Do you review the extensions installed on your device from time to time?
